title: Record the 2366-byte LocalNet matrix and say that 0x05 reuses the handshake session key
description: Record the 2366-byte LocalNet matrix and say that 0x05 reuses the handshake session key
acceptance_criteria: PROTOCOL.md says everyday and Extra lock messages use a fresh ephemeral key, and a 0x05 message reuses the handshake session key. PARITY.md records LocalNet rounds 41641 through 41736 for the 2366-byte handshake and marks rounds 41059 through 41154 as withdrawn.
